_meta.title: ResolvrNow companion data: Service Catalog, Request Management, Knowledge, Portal, Universal Request, Virtual Agent, Walk-up
_meta.release: ServiceNow Brazil public docs plus SDK table metadata

conventions.choices: Each choice is {value,label,sequence,dependentValue}. Basis notes live in _meta.choiceBasis.
conventions.tables: Tables use the SDK JSON shape (label, extends, audit, number, columns) like the sibling data files. 'extendsExisting: true' means merge the columns into the SDK table of the same name (server/src/schema/sdk/sdk-tables.json). 'note' starts with the Documented / Inferred basis.
conventions.constants: variableTypes (item_option_new.type codes), properties (name -> type, default, area, basis), numbering, events, roles.
conventions.basis: Documented = stated in public docs; Inferred = filled gap or ResolvrNow decision.

choiceBasis.sc_request.request_state: Labels Pending Approval / closure outcomes documented; values inferred (default 'requested' from SDK JSON)
choiceBasis.sc_request.state: Labels documented (closure roll-up); integers inferred (task convention)
choiceBasis.sc_req_item.state: Labels documented (Universal Request state mapping); integers inferred
choiceBasis.sc_req_item.stage: Labels Waiting for Approval, Fulfillment, Delivery, Completed documented; values inferred
choiceBasis.task.approval: Values documented (Case API approval field); labels inferred except Not Yet Requested
choiceBasis.sc_cat_item.recurring_frequency: Labels Monthly/Annually and keys daily/monthly/yearly documented (API); rest inferred
choiceBasis.item_option_new.type: Codes 2, 6, 7 documented (API sample); others inferred platform convention
choiceBasis.item_option_new_set.type: Labels documented; values from SDK JSON default 'one_to_one'
choiceBasis.kb_knowledge.workflow_state: Labels documented; values draft/review/published documented, others inferred
choiceBasis.kb_knowledge.article_type: HTML or wiki documented; values inferred (SDK default 'text')
choiceBasis.kb_knowledge.governance: Labels documented (experience / compliance based); values inferred
choiceBasis.kb_submission.status: Closed outcomes documented via event names; values inferred
choiceBasis.universal_request.state: Labels New, In Progress, Closed documented; Awaiting, Canceled and all values inferred
choiceBasis.portal_ticket_config.show_description: Labels documented (ticket configuration form); values inferred
choiceBasis.asmt_assessment_instance.state: Inferred (survey state docs not in corpus)
choiceBasis.sn_ex_sp_quick_link.content_type: Inferred (quick link content types documented as a concept)
